newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFin 4 in demand, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFin 4 in demand, others steady.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were steady on Wednesday in the absence of market-moving factors but dealers said a Russian bank was buying the fourth tranche apparently on client demand.

"A Russian bank was buying actively, mainly the fourth tranche but the day was otherwise quiet. Emerging markets are still looking at U.S. Treasuries and not at the local news," a Deutsche Morgan Grenfell dealer said.
Dealers said the 2003 maturity had run into resistance at 60.95.
"Buying in the fourth tranche looked like client demand. Its price eased later, and trading is generally going on in the same ranges," a Russian bank dealer said.
Dealers forecast more lively trading on Friday when U.S. retail sales figures for March are due.
